purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed NYC flights departure and arrival records for 2013, feeding downstream analytics on flight timing, delays, and route performance.
usage: Consumers should join on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) and must explicitly handle nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time, which represent cancelled or diverted flights rather than data-quality errors.
limitations: Roughly 3 percent of rows (null_rate 0.029388 to 0.032981) lack departure/arrival timing and delay data, and 0.9 percent lack a tailnum (null_rate 0.009154); these nulls were retained rather than resolved, and the table carries no row count beyond the 166158 profiled, so any further growth or duplicate patterns are not reflected here.
